title: Cross-Border Investments in Private Firms: The Benefits of Comparability for Foreign Investors
authors: Kristian D. Allee; Tami Dinh; Arthur Stenzel
near_miss_reason: The main analysis (Tables 4-6) is a single-date reform (BilMoG 2010, de x postbm) and is not staggered. Table 7 (UK external validity) uses staggered voluntary IFRS adoption by UK private firms (ifrs_post switches on at firm-specific years) with firm and year FE in columns 3/6/9/12/15, but every column includes six time-varying firm controls ($controls1) and the ever-adopter dummy; several columns add entropy-balancing, CEM or PSM weights.
eligible_reason: No reported column of the staggered (UK) design is free of time-varying controls.
design_notes: AT/DE firm-year panel 2006-2013 from Orbis (anonymized derived data shipped). Treatment: German unlisted firms after BilMoG (postbm) vs Austrian unlisted (de==0) or German listed (unlist==0) controls; reghdfe with sic1 FE, clustered by id and yr; EB, CEM, PSM robustness. Table 7: UK private firms 2013-2017, ifrs_firm/ifrs_post, sic1#fyear FE or id + fyear FE, controls1, cluster id fyear or id.
estimators_reported: two-group DiD with industry FE and controls (single date)
staggered DiD with firm and year FE plus controls (Table 7 UK)
main_or_robustness: robustness (staggered design appears only in Table 7 external-validity analysis)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (size lev dsales roa_lagat neg_dsales neg_roa) in every column; ifrs_firm included alongside firm FE
specs.treatment_definition: voluntary IFRS adoption by UK private firms at firm-specific fiscal years (post_new = 1 from the adoption year onward); ifrs_firm = ever-adopter
specs.fe: id + fyear (ab_var_firm); other columns use sic1#fyear only
specs.controls: $controls1 = size lev dsales roa_lagat neg_dsales neg_roa
specs.sample_condition: UK private firms 2013-2017 (UK_shrhldr_data_WD_250730.dta); CEM/PSM subsamples in later columns

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (German BilMoG reform, postbm = fiscal years from 2010); two-group DiD de x postbm or unlist x postbm with industry FE (no firm FE) and controls

screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.pdf, 002_code/*.do). Batch metadata year 2022 looks inconsistent with the DOI (2024 submission); check against the article page.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: UK voluntary IFRS adoption years within 2013-2017 (not extracted).
